retell: The top US spy boss is going to run a White House team that has 120 days to report on the dangers of AI.
AI companies sold more new shares in Hong Kong this summer than ever before, but higher borrowing costs are making buyers more cautious.
A safety boss at OpenAI quit and said the company's culture is broken, and OpenAI replied that it delays its AI when it has to.
problem: 'models' is a jargon word: a stranger does not know a 'model' means an AI system, so 'holds back models' is unclear the first time.
fix: In security. An OpenAI safety lead quit, calling the company's culture broken. OpenAI says it holds back its A I systems when needed.

retell: Elon Musk said chip maker TSMC might join his Terafab project, but it is only talks and TSMC has said nothing.
problem: 'his Terafab plant' is never introduced: a stranger does not know what Terafab is or what kind of plant it means.
fix: In energy. Elon Musk confirmed chip maker T S M C may join his Terafab chip factory. He calls it just talks, and T S M C has not commented.

retell: Tesla's self-driving taxi had a rough first month in Austin, and officials are checking how Tesla got a car with no steering wheel or pedals approved.
A famous Indian actor promised to sue over a fake sexual video of his co-star and wants the government to make strict rules against misusing AI.
Mayo Clinic researchers say AI found signs of pancreatic cancer risk up to five years early, but other scientists have not checked the result yet.
A French TV host boxed two human-shaped robots and knocked them both down, the videos went viral, and people joke the robots will remember.
The US Treasury boss told AI companies to take responsibility for their own risks, and Kawasaki wants to sell a human-shaped robot by 2030.
problem: 'own their risks' is a business idiom: a stranger may hear 'own' as 'possess' and miss that it means take responsibility.
fix: Also in the full report: the U S Treasury chief tells A I firms to take responsibility for their risks. Kawasaki wants a humanoid robot sold by twenty thirty.

retell: People who put money into AI disagree: share buyers keep buying while debt experts warn of a crash, so watch whether Anthropic's stock market debut gets cut or delayed.
problem: Three things unclear on first hearing: 'A I money is split' does not say who is split; 'debt watchers' is jargon; 'an-thropic' is named without saying it is an AI company.
fix: And for the bigger picture: A I investors are split. Share buyers keep buying, debt experts warn of a sharp fall. Watch A I firm an-thropic's stock market listing: a cut or delay would back the doubters.
